# github_enterprise_team_membership (Data Source)

Looks up a direct or IdP-managed team membership. Missing memberships produce an error; authorization errors are never reported as non-membership.

## Example

```hcl
data "github_enterprise_team_membership" "example" {
  provider = github-enterprise

  team_id  = 123456
  username = "octocat"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Optional | Enterprise account slug. Defaults to the provider-level enterprise_slug. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug/team_id/username. |
| `is_member` | `Bool` | Read-only | True when the membership exists. A missing membership is an error. |
| `team_id` | `Number` | Required | Numeric enterprise team ID. |
| `user_id` | `Number` | Read-only | Numeric user ID. |
| `username` | `String` | Required | GitHub username. |

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
